Broncos Depth Chart Released Ahead of Rams Game

The Denver Broncos have released their depth chart in anticipation of their upcoming game against the Los Angeles Rams. Rams star Puka Nacua remains questionable to play in Sunday's matchup. One outlet's picks suggest the Broncos will defeat the Rams in what is described as a potential Super Bowl preview.
